resources.string: Enable Minimal Keyboard in Android System Settings
Set Minimal Keyboard as your active input method
Keyboard is active and ready to type!
Keyboard is enabled. Tap below to select it.

Minimal Keyboard is strictly offline. It requests no INTERNET permission, stores no typing history, transmits no keystrokes, and contains no analytics or advertising SDKs. What you type stays entirely on your screen.
